bug_semantics: OliveTin RestartAction is a confused deputy: it looks up a prior execution by tracking ID, then calls StartAction with a newly constructed connect.Request that carries only BindingId and UniqueTrackingId and does not copy the original caller's Cookie/Authorization headers. StartAction authenticates with auth.UserFromApiCall(ctx, req, cfg), which runs the cookie/header auth chain against that synthetic request. Missing credentials make UserFromApiCall fall back to the guest user, so a low-privilege authenticated caller whose exec permission is false can still cause the bound shell action to run if guest.exec is true.
flaw_origin: RestartAction was first stubbed in 570c0ba087d22868978f86127f07cdbfff78a0a0 as a headerless internal StartAction call with `// FIXME` and no BindingId, so StartAction's FindBindingByID("") returned nil and the handler exited CodeNotFound without executing. Request-based auth (and guest fallback) later replaced context metadata. The smallest commit that first wrote the exploitable lines is 4744169aa013a7360449418d5bfef8845b2ff8b4, which replaced the FIXME with BindingId: execReqLogEntry.GetBindingId() so the synthetic request both identified an action and still lacked caller cookies/headers. Immediate parent e9a3863b1b9da97ce9377e8f6e87f3fc90de7449 still has the FIXME stub; no finer public member of 4744169 is reconstructable.

StartAction at that commit (lines 112-142) does pair := api.executor.FindBindingByID(req.Msg.BindingId) and returns CodeNotFound if pair is nil. FindBindingByID is a map lookup; generateActionBindingId returns action.ID or a sha256 hex, never "". Empty protobuf BindingId cannot execute.

At 4744169 StartAction line 125: authenticatedUser := auth.UserFromApiCall(ctx, req, api.cfg). service/internal/auth/authcheck.go UserFromApiCall runs runAuthChain on req.Header() (local session cookie olivetin-sid-local, JWT, trusted headers) and if user == nil || user.Username == "" substitutes UserGuest(cfg). A headerless synthetic connect.Request therefore always authenticates as guest.
